finding.what: the awaiting-confirmation page is served with HTTP 400. The page itself is correct and is a legitimate intermediate state — sources found, nothing read until the user chooses — but 400 says the CLIENT sent a bad request, which it did not
finding.why_it_matters: anything that polls a run by status code reads this state as a malformed submission and stops; the page says 'review the sources and start the analysis', which is the opposite of an error
finding.not_fixed_here: the founder surface is a different branch and a different deployment from the market work in this wave; recorded rather than reached across
